title: Initiate Energy Infrastructure Fund at 5% in Growth and Balanced models
summary: Adds the Arbor Peak Energy Infrastructure Fund to Growth and Balanced models at a 5% weight, funded from fixed income.

title: Add Cybersecurity Leaders Fund at 4% in Growth models
summary: Adds the Arbor Peak Cybersecurity Leaders Fund to Growth models at 4%, funded from the Global Technology Fund.

title: Increase AI Infrastructure Fund allocation: Growth 5% to 8%, Balanced 3% to 5%
summary: Raises the AI Infrastructure Fund model weight on sustained demand for GPU capacity through 2027. Funded from fixed income. Chief Risk Officer dissented on concentration grounds.

title: Shorten Core Fixed Income duration target from 6.0 to 5.0 years
summary: Reduces duration risk in the Core Fixed Income Fund given rate-path uncertainty. No client trades required.

title: Approve $45M senior secured term loan to Cobalt Ridge Data Centers
summary: Private Credit Fund II commits $45M to a senior secured term loan financing a GPU-dense data center campus. Funded by capital call #6.

title: Increase Energy Infrastructure Fund allocation from 5% to 7% on data center power demand
summary: Raises the Energy Infrastructure Fund weight in Growth and Balanced models; thesis is natural gas demand from new data center power generation. Clients with fossil-fuel exclusions are exempt.

title: Adopt 10% single-name cap and reduce technology overlap for clients above the 15% AI look-through guideline
summary: Caps any single company at 10% of a thematic fund (Nvidia trimmed from 12% to 10% in the AI Infrastructure Fund) and reduces Global Technology Fund holdings for clients whose look-through AI Infrastructure exposure exceeds 15%.

title: Approve $20M senior secured facility to Polar Loop Cooling Systems; maintain 8% AI Infrastructure allocation
summary: Private Credit Fund II commits $20M to a liquid-cooling manufacturer serving AI data centers, funded by capital call #7. AI Infrastructure model weight maintained at 8%.
